about.label: About
about.headline: Frontend engineer at Melal Bank (FAM), building CoreOffice and the systems around it.
about.p1: Day to day I work on CoreOffice—an enterprise ERP for banking operations. I migrated the legacy CRA frontend to a Turborepo monorepo (Next.js, Storybook, Docusaurus), built the branch portal where staff upload documents that flow into CoreOffice, and shipped modules for loan intake, relationship graphs, and BPMN cartables.
about.p2: I care about the full delivery loop: Dockerized apps, BFF layers with their own observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Graylog), Nginx hardening, and UI that stays maintainable at scale. Side projects include an open-source crypto dashboard and a thesis LLM chatbot.
focus: CoreOffice ERP rewrite — Next.js, Turborepo, TanStack Query
Branch portal — uploads for transparency, payslips, debt collection
D3 relationship graph module inside CoreOffice
BFF monitoring stack for production Next.js apps

projects.label: Selected Work
projects.title: Modules inside CoreOffice
projects.subtitle: Most of this work is one platform at Melal Bank—not six unrelated products. Scroll horizontally through each module's screens, then continue to the next.

coreoffice.title: CoreOffice — ERP rewrite & branch portal
coreoffice.description: The main system I work on daily. Rewrote legacy CoreOffice from CRA to a Turborepo monorepo (Next.js, Storybook, Docusaurus). Built a branch portal where staff upload transparency files, payslips, and debt-collection documents—data lands in CoreOffice tables and downstream workflows.
story: Full frontend migration: CRA → Turborepo + Next.js + TanStack Query
Branch portal for document uploads that sync into CoreOffice
Shared CSS Modules design language with Storybook coverage
Dockerized deployments across dev and production

loan.title: Loan facilities — vama.melalbank.ir
loan.description: Customer-facing loan application site (Next.js, Docker). Applicants submit requests publicly; branch staff receive and process them inside CoreOffice cartables.
story: Public SSR flows for loan requests and facility info
Submitted data flows into CoreOffice for branch review

graph.title: Relationship graph module
graph.description: D3 force-directed graph shipped as a CoreOffice menu module. Auditors explore entity relationships that were unreadable in flat tables—used in ISMS certification workflows.
story: Interactive pan/zoom with progressive node disclosure
Embedded inside CoreOffice, not a standalone app
Replaced dense relational tables with visual tracing

workflow.title: BPMN cartable & process UI
workflow.description: Per-user task inboxes driven by BPMN. Each organizational request shows who holds it now, where it goes next, and the full flow history—all inside CoreOffice.
story: Form.io renders dynamic forms from BPMN definitions
Camunda routes tasks, approvals, and role handoffs
Staff track requests from submission to completion

crypto.title: Crypto rate dashboard
crypto.description: Early portfolio project while learning React Query and i18n—multi-language crypto dashboard with pagination, dark/light mode, and live market data. Source on GitHub.
story: First structured frontend project — React Query + i18n
Built in a Turborepo layout during iApps internship
Real-time rates with paginated market views

monitoring.title: BFF observability stack
monitoring.description: Monitoring for our Next.js BFF apps (loan platform & branch portal). Prometheus, Grafana, and Graylog let us inspect logs and metrics on our edge layer—not only on the main backend.
story: Prometheus exporters + Grafana dashboards (CPU, memory, network)
Graylog for structured log search and alerting
Critical for BFF apps where we own the production edge
